svg.title: A Boolean circuit of 9 two-input gates on 5 inputs that outputs 1 exactly when x1 + … + x5 leaves remainder 1 on division by 3, checked on all 32 inputs; every gate leads to the output.
svg.desc: A Boolean circuit of 9 two-input gates on 5 inputs that outputs 1 exactly when x1 + … + x5 leaves remainder 1 on division by 3, checked on all 32 inputs; every gate leads to the output. Inputs on the top row, each gate on the row of its depth (8 levels), coloured by its operation, the output ringed; along the bottom, its value on each input in order, 1 on 10 of the 32.
